name: Carrier channel supervision alarm
aliases: Line carrier and protection communication interfaces
switchyards Line carrier and protection communication interfaces
summary: Reports the documented unhealthy condition of the selected carrier communication path.
description: Reports the documented unhealthy condition of the selected carrier communication path. A protection communication interface carries information between circuit ends or couples a communication signal to a primary line. Its signal path is different from the power-current path even when both use part of the same installation.

In a switchyard line bay, carrier-coupling equipment can connect a protection communication terminal to the transmission conductor. Fiber-based protection uses another physical path but still needs named endpoints and channel supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Carrier channel health” at the input and “Channel fault alarm” at the output. Protection fallback must be separately specified.
